cq_coverage.CQ1: The object property :playsInstrument (Person -> Instrument) answers what instruments a person plays.
cq_coverage.CQ2: The pivot class :BandMembership, with properties :hasBandMembership (Person->BandMembership), :memberOf (BandMembership->Band), :membershipStart, :membershipEnd, provides membership info at points in time.
cq_coverage.CQ3: As above, with :hasRole (BandMembership->Role) indicating the role in a band at a time.
cq_coverage.CQ4: Data properties :albumRecordingStart and :albumRecordingEnd (on Album) provide the recording period.
cq_coverage.CQ5: Object property :containsTrack (Album->Track) with cardinality restriction (min 1) answers track count.
cq_coverage.CQ6: Data property :releasedOn (Album->xsd:date) gives the release date.
cq_coverage.CQ7: Object property :trackOfSong (Track->Song) links tracks to songs.
cq_coverage.CQ9: Pivot class :Critique, with :hasCritique (Album->Critique), :givenBy (Critique->Critic), and :critiqueText (Critique->string) models critic statements about records.
cq_coverage.CQ11: Object property :performedSong (Performance->Song) lists songs played at a performance.
cq_coverage.CQ13: Object property :locatedInRegion (City->Region) gives region for a city.
cq_coverage.CQ14: Object property :locatedInCountry (Region->Country) gives country for a region.
cq_coverage.CQ15: Cardinality restriction (Album owl:equivalentClass [owl:onProperty :containsTrack; owl:minCardinality 1]) ensures every album has at least one track.
